metadata.title: Hyper Velocity Stars and the Restricted Parabolic 3-body Problem

notes: No individual star meets either contribution category. The paper refers to the observed hypervelocity-star population only in aggregate, without individual names or identifiers (T:p1-b9). Its sole named star, SO-2, is discussed only as a bound Galactic Center object in connection with a prior binary-origin claim, not as a Galactic unbound candidate (T:p10-b9). The unnamed hypothetical companion is not an identifiable star, and an ejection mechanism alone does not establish candidacy.
